description: Use for: visual verification — layout, images, charts, CAPTCHA presence, or evidence of page state. Returns a PNG image (JPEG if the PNG exceeds 2.5MB). Don't use when: you only need the page's content or structure — browser_extract and browser_snapshot are far cheaper in tokens. Paid: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 on Base.

full_page.description: Capture the full scrollable page instead of the viewport.

session_id.description: Session ID. Reuse the same ID to keep cookies, login state and page position across calls; a new ID starts a fresh browser.

name: browser_screenshot
title: Screenshot the current page
